services.name: 180Climate Fieldwork Network
services.description: Private matching and consent-controlled introductions for authorised, low-risk fieldwork support in Indonesia.
eligibility: No regulated conclusion without an accountable qualified provider
limitations: Applications are currently received and reviewed through the private 180Climate Wix form; this service does not issue a native status key for those submissions
A match is not a booking, dispatch, site-access approval, endorsement or professional certification
The pilot does not process payments or collect bank or card details
Contact is not revealed until both named parties consent and an operator confirms the introduction
approval_points: Site access and any direct agreement

services.name: EUDR Plot Screening
services.description: Early plot screening and preparation support for EUDR due-diligence workflows.
limitations: Screening can be unknown or inconclusive
The result is not an official due-diligence statement or legal clearance

services.name: Carbon Pre-Feasibility
services.description: Indicative screening to decide whether a forest or land opportunity merits deeper assessment.
limitations: Preliminary screening, not a bankable study, valuation or investment recommendation
Assumptions, missing evidence and expert-review needs remain material
